title: OnRecordLoad trigger
description: Performance rule — OnRecordLoad script triggers. They fire for every record scrolled into view; heavy scripts here slow down list views and finds.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: OnRecordLoad runs on every record load; a slow script multiplies across the found set.
rule.remediation: Keep the trigger script minimal, or move heavy work to an explicit user action.
